source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check SUT time after system warm reboot
1. Disable NTP function in OS
2. Adjust SUT time to match with a standard time
3. Start a system warm reboot for 1000 times
4. Check SUT time after reboot test completes

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. NTP should be disabled successfully
2. SUT time should be adjusted successfully
3. SUT time should be accuracy (The tolerance is within 5 secend)

original_test_intent: Measure SUT clock accuracy after exactly 1000 completed warm reboots with NTP disabled and the initial clock aligned to a standard, while proving successful recovery and health for every cycle.
original_method: Disable the active OS time service, align time to an authoritative reference, run the approved warm-reboot harness for 1000 cycles with a boot/health gate between cycles, compare final SUT time with the same reference within five seconds, then restore synchronization.
manual_activity: No physical test action is inherently required. A user supplies and approves the immutable 1000-cycle plan, reference and recovery; the agent can perform the warm-reboot loop and evidence collection. Approval and engineer verdict do not make it PARTIAL.
required_inputs: Reviewed source-linked harness contents/version and exact warm-reboot command
Target OS/platform, reboot interval, reconnect method, boot-complete and service-health gates
NTP disable/restore procedure and affected-service mitigation
OOB recovery, maintenance isolation and one-user approval for 1000 cycles
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated SUT; repeated reboots can expose storage, bootloader, firmware and service failures.
Validate one planned cycle and recovery path before authorizing the unchanged full plan, without crediting it toward the run unless the plan says so.
Stop on the first boot/health/storage/SEL/time-service failure; preserve it and do not automatically retry or hide the failed iteration.
Do not clear logs and restore synchronization only after evidence capture or an approved abort.
agent_execution_scope: Validate harness, SUT, reference, recovery and baseline state before starting.
Execute exactly the approved cycle count, gating each next reboot on completed boot and health evidence and preserving every failure.
Measure final clock offset, restore NTP, summarize tool/cycle results and leave formal PASS/FAIL to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the target, cycle count, health gate, time reference and recovery boundaries.
Remain responsible for OOB/manual recovery if the automated run stops.
Review cycle completeness, clock measurement and anomalies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A single SSH reboot is a primitive that may be used inside a validated harness, but alone it neither manages 1000 iterations nor verifies boot health, exact count or clock accuracy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Prefer the reviewed existing project/PA Manager cycle script when it implements the source semantics. Do not infer the private linked script's behavior, retry policy or supported platform without its contents.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exactly 1000 warm reboots, NTP disabled, initial alignment, five-second final tolerance, script URL and 15/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record an immutable run manifest; for each warm reboot store iteration, trigger time, disconnect/reconnect, boot ID, service/storage/BMC health and duration. Stop without retry on failure, then pair the final SUT/reference timestamps and restore NTP.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact SUT, OS and reboot interface validated by the project harness.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record harness commit/hash, OS/kernel, BIOS, BMC, storage firmware and time-service versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-reviewed private cycle-script source plus platform warm-reboot and recovery procedures.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic per-cycle control, recovery boundary and traceable time measurement without reducing count.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; a one-reboot sample is explicitly rejected.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Harness, gates, reference, recovery and approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management connectivity alone does not prove full OS/service or storage health.

project_override_considerations: The public library retains 1000 cycles. A project may approve 100 cycles and the agent may report that approved plan completed, but must not claim the unexecuted 1000-cycle source requirement passed. Missing harness/spec parameters affect readiness, not automation capability or permanent blockage.
expected_evidence: Immutable run plan, harness hash/version, target identity, reference/time-service state, recovery and approval
Exactly 1000 unique iteration records with boot IDs, timing and per-cycle boot/service/storage/BMC gates
Complete raw failure evidence if stopped, with no automatic retries
Final paired clock/reference measurement within stated uncertainty, restored NTP, health summary and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires 1000 warm reboots and final clock accuracy. Machine Time 0 is a planning-field anomaly, not an instruction that contradicts the explicit cycle count.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The semantics are clear and the full core can be automated after supplying the cycle package and safety parameters. V3.1 does not treat missing package/project inputs as permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject its reduction to one reboot/uptime and retain only the warm-reboot primitive after harness validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keep its cycle/recovery/time gates while changing BLOCKED to NOT READY and classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies the locked distinction between automation capability, readiness, execution status and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Restores full count and clock coverage, defines iteration identity and forbids hidden retries, while allowing an approved project count to be reported honestly without rewriting the master source.
independent_technical_reasoning: Warm reboot control, reconnection, boot-ID verification, health checks and time measurement are software-automatable. The required user approval and missing private harness contents only delay readiness. With no intrinsic human/physical core, FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct.
